description: Commission of Elections - Appointed Mr. Suduhakuruge Ketin as a member of Kalutara P/S
categorisation: This gazette content specifically addresses the filling of a vacancy in a local government body (Kalutara Pradeshiya Sabha) under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It involves electoral procedures, candidate nominations, and declarations by election officials, which directly falls under Election-related matters (Type 7) rather than government personnel changes or other specialized categories.
